MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The locking nuts fit my recent interest in fastening supplies, provided their sizes match the bolts I use.",
    "The VELCRO tape connects to my mounting needs because it could help attach lightweight objects to smooth surfaces."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Calipers and temperature guns are tools, but they do not help with the fastening and mounting tasks reflected in my recent purchases.",
    "Cutting wheels assume a metal-cutting task and compatible equipment that my purchases do not establish, while epoxy offers a permanent bond when I am currently choosing mechanical fasteners.",
    "Disposable medicine cups do not imply that I need glass beakers, pH testing supplies, or specialized liquid storage."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Buying construction fasteners seems to have been treated as a reason to recommend almost any workshop tool or repair supply.",
    "My medicine cup purchase seems to have been stretched into an interest in laboratory equipment, even though measuring or dispensing small amounts does not establish that need."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My repeated nail, screw, and anchor purchases point most clearly toward fastening and mounting; dimensions, materials, and compatibility matter to whether another item is useful.",
    "Related supplies still need to serve an immediate task: removable mounting tape could complement my supplies, but permanent adhesive and measurement tools do not automatically follow."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognized my fastening and mounting needs but extended them too broadly into unrelated tools and laboratory supplies."
}
